headline: Bishkek grocery basket as of 21 November: in a week, not a single product became cheaper
summary: In Bishkek, none of the products in the weekly grocery basket got cheaper over the past week. Bread, buckwheat, potatoes, cucumbers, tomatoes and other items rose in price.
why: Food price trends feed into consumer inflation, which influences central bank policy and household purchasing power.
original_headline: Продуктовая корзина Бишкека на 21 ноября: за неделю ни один продукт не подешевел
